params.1273: Help Isold the militiaman get geared up for war.
params.1274: If you need leather gloves, you can kill a cow, tan the cowhide and then stitch the leather into gloves.
params.1275: If you need a bronze helm, you can mine copper and tin, smelt them and then smith the bronze bar into a helm.
params.1276: Talk to <col=FFFFFF>Isold</col> with a pair of <col=FFFFFF>leather gloves</col> and a <col=FFFFFF>bronze helm</col>.
